'''{{PAGENAME}}''', added in ''[[Update Log#Update 6.5 - Jujutsu Kaisen Update Part 2|Update 6.5]]'', are a way to increase the stats of any unit at the cost of another stat. Are you willing to sacrifice something?


==Requirement==
To curse a unit, you need at least one {{Item|Cursed Finger}} which can be obtained from the '''[[Dungeons#Cursed_Womb|Cursed Womb]]''' dungeon. To enter the '''[[Dungeons#Cursed_Womb|Cursed Womb]]''' dungeon, you need a Cursed Womb key which can be dropped from secret enemies that spawn in '''Cursed Academy Infinite'''

==Where to curse units==
After you've received your first Cursed Finger, click/tap on it in your '''Items Or Go To Your Area''' and you'll be brought to ''Sukuno's'' ([https://jujutsu-kaisen.fandom.com/wiki/Sukuna Sukuna])domain
